content: If return value of the function Dem_J193 9DcmClearDTC is DEM _PENDING, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC (with parameter DTCTypeFilter set to 'DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_ACTIVE') in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.

If return value of the function Dem_J193 9DcmClearDTC is DEM _PENDING, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC (with parameter DTCTypeFilter set to 'DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_ACTIVE') in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.

If return value of the function Dem_J193 9DcmClearDTC is DEM _PENDING, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC (with parameter DTCTypeFilter set to 'DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_ACTIVE') in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.
